purpose: Preserve an additive, provenance-bound restoration plan for three deleted room-world drafts without restoring, deleting, or rewriting repository history.

governance.observed: operations/CURRENT_STATE.json prohibits deleting GitHub files or history.
governance.inferred: A collision-free archive restoration can preserve addressability without reactivating superseded runtime code.
governance.proposed: If canonical approval is later recorded, restore each artifact only to its proposed archive path and mark it inactive and non-importable.
unresolved: Whether the no-deletion rule applies to working-tree paths, Git history, or both.
Whether canonical maintainers want the deleted drafts restored as source archives.
Whether dependency snapshots should also be archived to make the drafts independently reproducible.

restoration_risks: Restoring to the original path could shadow or conflict with the active room-world implementation.
The historical imports may have changed since deletion.
Treating archived source as executable could reactivate obsolete accessibility, audio, persistence, or performance behavior.
Restoring to the original path could create an ambiguous component choice.
Compressed historical logic is harder to audit and may conceal behavior drift.
The historical localStorage namespace and audio behavior may conflict with the active runtime.
Restoring to the original path could conflict with the currently staged wordless-room runtime.
The draft contains direct browser storage, canvas, pointer, and audio behavior that requires renewed accessibility and mobile verification.
Its dependency graph may no longer match current source contracts.

restoration_preconditions: A canonical decision explicitly defines the scope of the no-deletion rule.
A canonical decision authorizes additive archive restoration.
The restored files use only collision-free archive paths and cannot be imported by the application build.
Each restored file records its deletion commit, original path, inactive status, and verification limits.
No existing file is overwritten or deleted.

verification.method: Matched each deletion commit message and deletion diff to one unique original path; no historical identifier was reconstructed beyond immutable commit evidence.
verification.coverage: three known deletion commits named as superseded room-world drafts
verification.limitations: This is not an exhaustive branch inventory and does not prove that no additional deleted room-world artifacts exist.

privacy_boundary: Repository paths, commit identifiers, abstract dependency names, and lifecycle semantics only; no private chats, credentials, personal records, or unreviewed file-library content retained.
